title: Agent Data Flow Step-Through
description: The learner will explain which of three parts (terminal, network, server) performs each of the eight steps that carry a spoken question to a spoken answer, by predicting the owner of steps 2 to 8 with at least 6 of 7 correct.
creator: Open Study Buddy
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Open Study Buddy
chapter_title: Personal Agents and the Open Study Buddy Architecture

educational.topic: Agent data flow from spoken question to spoken answer
learningObjectives: The learner will explain which of three parts (terminal, network, server) performs each of the eight steps that carry a spoken question to a spoken answer, by predicting the owner of steps 2 to 8 with at least 6 of 7 correct.

pedagogical.pattern: Step-through with prediction before reveal and concrete data at each step (no animation)
misconceptionsAddressed: The microphone sends sound straight to the speaker.
The Wi-Fi link understands the question.
pedagogical.assessment: Mastery is 6 of 7 owner predictions correct for steps 2 to 8.
pedagogical.defaultState: Opens at the first item with nothing answered; there is no animation or timer.
